test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 3 March 2023)
subject: general
question: Two candidates contested an election. One of them got 64% of the votes and won by 434 votes. What was the total number of votes polled?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The winning candidate got 64% of the total votes.

The losing candidate got (100% − 64%) = 36% of the total votes.

Difference in vote percentage = 64% − 36% = 28%

Given, 28% of total votes = 434

Total votes = 434 × (100 ÷ 28) = 1550

**∴ The correct answer is 1550.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Votes polled by the winning candidate = 64%

Winning margin = 434 votes

Total votes percentage = 100%

 Total Votes = 100%

 

 
 Winner (64%)

 
 Loser (36%)

 
• 
 
• 
 

 

 

 
 Difference = 64% − 36% = 28%
 
 28% → 434 votes

**Calculations:**

⇒ Votes polled by the losing candidate = 100% − 64% = 36%

⇒ Difference in percentage = 64% − 36% = 28%

Since the winning margin is 434 votes:

⇒ 28% of Total Votes = 434

⇒ 1% of Total Votes = 434 ÷ 28 = 15.5

⇒ Total Votes (100%) = 15.5 × 100 = 1550

**∴ The correct answer is 1550.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Valid and Invalid Votes

When certain votes are declared invalid, the percentage calculations are usually based on valid votes. Total Valid Votes = Total Votes Polled − Invalid Votes.

Percentage Change and Base

In election problems, percentages are calculated with respect to the total voter base unless stated otherwise. The winning margin is always the difference in percentages between the winner and the loser.

Successive Percentage Shift

When counting the active voting population: Final Valid Votes = Total Registered Voters × (1 − Non-voters%) × (1 − Invalid%).
